AgentStatusExtensionDocument.description:
The authored Agent Status extension.

`enabled` composes the extension in or out of the runtime as a whole;
`time` and `background` remain the two bounded status contributors, with
exactly the semantics they had before the migration.

enabled.description:
Whether this composition includes the Agent Status extension at all.

With `false` the runtime composes no status engine: the Agent Loop
emits no Agent Status and is otherwise a completely ordinary
`ConversationRuntime`.

BackgroundStatusConfig.description: Configuration of the bounded Background status contributor.

enabled.description: Whether Background participates in an available Agent Status opportunity.

McpServerId.description: Identifies an MCP server bound to the runtime.

NativeAgentExtensionSelection.description:
The **presence-aware** closed selection an invocation override expresses.

This is deliberately *not* [`NativeAgentExtensionsDocument`]. The authored
document supplies launch/role **defaults** — its `agentStatus` member has
`enabled: true` — which is exactly right for "an unconfigured role composes
Agent Status" and exactly wrong for an override, where the whole point is
that a present `extensions` dimension **replaces** the role's composition:

```text
role frontmatter   extensions: {}   ->  Agent Status composed (role default)
invocation override "extensions": {} ->  no extension composed at all
```

Every member is therefore an explicit `Option`: absent means "this
extension is not part of the requested composition", never "use a default".
Presence is the only way to compose an extension, and a present member
still carries its own complete authored configuration.

The record stays closed exactly like the authored document: an unknown
extension name is rejected by `deny_unknown_fields`, so a misspelled or
not-yet-implemented extension fails deterministically instead of being
silently ignored.

agentStatus.description:
The requested Agent Status extension, when this selection composes it.

`null` is not accepted: the field is either absent (not composed) or a
complete authored configuration. Collapsing an explicit `null` into
"absent" would give one wire spelling two meanings.

SubagentInvocationOverride.description:
One invocation-scoped replacement of selected child capability
dimensions.

The same value is produced by model-generated `subagent` arguments and by
trusted static Workflow program data. The two differ only in the
[`SubagentOverrideAuthority`] their launch site supplies, never in this
vocabulary or in the resolution algorithm that consumes it.

[`SubagentOverrideAuthority`]: super::resolver::SubagentOverrideAuthority

extensions.description:
The complete replacement native Agent Extension composition, when this
dimension is overridden. Absent uses the definition's composition.

skills.description:
The complete replacement Skill selection, when this dimension is
overridden. Absent uses the definition's selection.

tools.description:
The complete replacement Tool selection, when this dimension is
overridden. Absent uses the definition's selection.

SubagentName.description:
The canonical typed name of one admitted subagent definition.

The keyspace is deliberately narrow: lowercase ASCII letters, digits,
`-`, and `_`, starting with a letter. A name is the model-facing routing
token, the durable ownership identity, and the Runtime Client projection
identity, so an ambiguous or shell-shaped spelling is rejected at the
configuration boundary rather than normalized later.

TimeStatusConfig.description: Configuration of the bounded Time status contributor.

enabled.description: Whether Time participates in an available Agent Status opportunity.

timezone.description:
The optional IANA timezone used only by Time presentation. Omitting it
renders UTC.

ToolSelectionDocument.description:
The authored map form of an exact, source-qualified capability selection.

This is the one selection vocabulary shared by every trusted authoring
surface: named-role frontmatter (`tools:`), a Workflow Agent node's
invocation override, and the model-facing `subagent` Tool's `override`.
Origins are named explicitly rather than collapsed into bare strings, so a
Builtin `read` and an MCP server's `read` are never interchangeable.
Wildcards are deliberately absent: a selection is an exact list. Managed
Python tool packages are selected through `mcp` under their synthesized
server identity (`python:<folder>`, Issue #174).

The `python:` namespace is reserved for those synthesized identities:
`mcpServers` configuration may never declare a server under it (rejected
during validation), so a selection naming `python:<folder>` always resolves
to the managed package, never to a configured server.

builtin.description: Built-in/native capabilities, by canonical model-facing name.

mcp.description: MCP capabilities, keyed by server identity.

ToolSelector.description:
Trusted selection syntax shared by Subagent and Workflow authoring.
Managed Python uses the existing `python:<package>` MCP server identity.

WorkflowBlock.description: A fixed lexical graph shared by root, Parallel branches and Loop bodies.

nodes.description: Stable node definitions keyed by explicit node id.

WorkflowBranch.description: One explicit input projection and fixed private Parallel block.

block.description: The child's private graph and contracts.

input.description: Evaluated in the parent scope and checked against the child input schema.

WorkflowEdgeDefinition.description: One explicit edge in the workflow graph.

port.description: Required Branch/Loop outcome port. Ordinary nodes must omit it.

WorkflowNodeDefinition.description: One Workflow node in the authoring/domain layer.

oneOf.description: Repeat one fixed typed body until its committed result satisfies `until`.
One statically selected, explicitly admitted foreground capability.
One execution of an admitted named Subagent profile.

input.description: Explicit input bindings from workflow-local values.

override.description:
The optional invocation-scoped capability override of this node
(Issue #258).

This is **trusted static program data**: it is part of the
compiled Workflow, is validated against the Workflow's own
admitted generation, and is not reachable from model output, node
input values, or task text. It may therefore legitimately replace
the role's defaults with capabilities the invoking main model does
not itself hold — never with capabilities the generation does not
authorize.

profile.description: The native named profile to resolve at `AgentRun` admission.

task.description: The fixed task instruction for this `AgentRun`.

oneOf.description: Deterministic selection from one committed boolean value.
A finite keyed set of private lexical blocks.

branches.description: Branches are keyed by definition identity, not completion order.

oneOf.description: Constructs a value and completes exactly this owning block.

WorkflowPredicate.description: Typed predicates. Equality requires matching scalar types; no coercion.

oneOf.description: Equal scalar operands of the same static type.
Unequal scalar operands of the same static type.
Conjunction of a nonempty fixed list.
Disjunction of a nonempty fixed list.

WorkflowToolResult.description: Select exactly one native content part, never provider text or log heuristics.

oneOf.description: The indexed part must be native structured JSON satisfying this schema.
The indexed part must be native text; retain it as a typed JSON string.

WorkflowValue.description: Closed, explicitly tagged value syntax; no evaluation of expression strings.

oneOf.description: First component is `args` or a local producer; remaining components are fields.
Literal JSON, including objects and arrays, never interpreted as syntax.

WorkflowWorkspace.description:
A managed candidate always preserves isolation. Dirty-parent opt-out is
explicit and retains the native committed-baseline/overlay semantics.

description: The canonical YAML/domain representation of one workflow.

description.description: The model-facing description of the workflow Tool.

timeout_ms.description: Trusted finite total foreground lifetime, including descendant waits.

tools.description: Explicit capability admission, independent of main model exposure.

workspace.description: Explicit run-scoped candidate acquisition; absent means no Git resource.
